These e-vowel belly forms select the first branch. Reviewed comparison: Goj peṭʰ “belly” (f_4boaexu44bdgk). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.

proposals.evidence: Reviewed whole-form continuation of Buksa kohaɖi “axe” (f_3dle65hbxxoom). Family evidence: CDIAL 3244 kuṭhāra gives kuhāṛī/kuvāṛī axe, with metathesis explicitly discussed and kurhāṛi attested. These survey k/q forms fit those documented variants; initial g needs separate support. Reviewed comparison: Buksa kuhaɖi “axe” (f_jecbmku4kcmb2).
